scope: Every P0 and P1 product behavior retained from the Go runtime or required by the replacement design. This records implementation and deterministic proof, not deployment or live acceptance.

status_semantics.implemented: The required behavior has Elixir implementation and deterministic proof at the referenced paths. This is not deployment proof.
status_semantics.partial: A usable Elixir subset exists and is proved, but the named gap remains owned by next_task.

capabilities.required_behavior: One PostgreSQL episode owns ordered input, lifecycle state, destination revision, waits, cancellation, and terminal fencing across restart.
A configured bearer or HMAC route accepts bounded arbitrary JSON, fixes authority and destination in host configuration, and records one idempotent generic input.
Authenticated Slack messages, edits, deletes, DMs, mentions, and configured proactive messages normalize to stable item identity and monotonic revisions.
Slack replies remain in the exact source thread, active conversations continue without another mention, and explicit channel or thread moves cannot borrow an older destination.
Signed GitHub issue comments, PR reviews, inline review comments, edits, deletes, and the eight native emoji normalize through the generic ingress contract with exact repository and thread identity.
Every source uses one bounded model decision contract; the model selects an abstract conversational, standard, or deep class while policy, repository, destination, and authority remain host-owned.

Durable Work runs through policy-pinned local or fleet Coop custody, validates frozen candidates, repairs semantic errors in the same turn, and reconciles ambiguous operations without duplicating work.
The active Coop session can call bounded Responder MCP tools for evidence, records, memory, schedules, waits, task offers, and host-confirmed platform effects without receiving host credentials.
Slack and Lab input files become bounded content-addressed artifact references with source visibility and enter the same frozen model context as their message.
Generated output artifacts are persisted and uploaded before a visible claim; retries retain exact bytes, identity, and destination.
Slack replies and reactions use immutable delivery custody, exact target receipts, metadata reconciliation, independent leases, bounded retry, and notification-safe rendering.
GitHub issue, PR review, and inline replies plus native reactions retain exact targets and reconcile opaque delivery markers before retrying a non-idempotent provider create.
Slack channel invitation and reconfiguration use a typed, operator-confirmed wizard with durable participation, repository, alert, and audience settings.
Typed memories and behaviors are scoped, provenance-bearing, bounded, expiring, advisory, and inert until a host-authorized confirmation stores them.
An authorized task offer creates one isolated writable Coop workspace, keeps its Slack thread, projects diff and review controls, and publishes only an exact reviewed tree to a draft PR.
Host-issued Slack and Lab offers are capability-, destination-, actor-, episode-, and revision-bound and disappear when their preconditions no longer hold.
Optional incident escalation creates an episode-linked room and durable card; evidence, lifecycle events, timeline, and postmortem remain projections rather than model assertions.

A directly requested exact operation is submitted to Emisar's governed contract, pauses on its authoritative approval URL, resumes in place, and verifies the terminal result without Slack granting authority.
Task and incident cards use stable provider identity, rebuild from durable state, repaint idempotently, and expose only currently authorized controls.
App Home renders durable active work, failures, memories, behaviors, and schedules and routes signed operator interactions back through host authorization.
A loopback-only control plane projects durable runtime state and a Conversation Lab crosses the real ingress, admission, Work, MCP, delivery, card, and recovery paths without external Slack effects.
The Investigate message shortcut fetches the selected Slack message, preserves exact thread identity, deduplicates retries, and enters ordinary generic ingress even when proactive listening is off.

Slack shows durable queued, admitting, working, delivery, and waiting status with generation fencing and paced refresh; admission yields to durable retry after a shared elapsed deadline; operators see phase age.
PostgreSQL owns leases and retry intent across normal restart; cleanup follows explicit ownership, closes exact Coop sessions, refuses unsafe workspace discard, and prunes by typed policy.
The immutable Elixir release is provenance-checked, migrates PostgreSQL, restarts one writer normally, exposes readiness, and has explicit backup, restore, activation, and rollback procedures.

Trusted configuration maps abstract work classes to exact Coop policies and authority-equivalent model targets; each attempt records policy, model metadata, usage, latency, and reported cost without letting model output widen authority.
A confirmed bounded standing assignment owns trigger, action, scope, initiative, cadence, expiry, and pause state and creates separately auditable child work.
Operators can run one read-only preflight and unified status, inspect every typed failure, retry the exact safe custody item, and replay a captured private Slack input without live delivery.
capabilities.gap: Delivery and several custody retries exist, but there is no unified Elixir preflight/status service or private no-delivery Slack replay outcome.

capabilities.required_behavior: Grafana firing and resolved notifications derive stable fingerprint, group correlation, lifecycle revision, and bounded normalized content before entering generic ingress.
capabilities.gap: Generic JSON ingress and lifecycle replay exist, but no trusted Grafana adapter derives provider identity and firing or resolved revisions.

capabilities.required_behavior: A configured route can map bounded JSON paths into stable item, event, actor, occurrence, revision, and compact content fields without payload-selected authority or embedded scripting.
capabilities.gap: Routes accept arbitrary authenticated JSON but do not yet implement the old bounded field-mapping contract.

capabilities.required_behavior: A GitHub conversation turn can fetch bounded issue or PR body, comments, review threads, changed files, and search results under the exact repository binding.
capabilities.gap: GitHub ingress and delivery work, but the model cannot yet read and search the broader bounded issue and PR context.

capabilities.required_behavior: Responder status comments expose idempotent, actor-authorized textual confirmations for supported offers and retain exact source revision without granting merge or deployment authority.
capabilities.gap: GitHub can receive and reply, but it has no supported confirmation syntax or durable offer execution surface.

capabilities.required_behavior: Each conversation retains a compact typed situation with goals, decisions, evidence, topology, open loops, and questions; bounded rollups survive Coop session rotation and retention compaction.
capabilities.gap: Explicit memory and episode history exist, but the Go situation summary and deterministic continuity-rollup layer has not been rebuilt.

capabilities.required_behavior: Recall prefers same-conversation and same-repository history and intersects private-channel visibility with current membership before crossing a channel boundary.
capabilities.gap: Typed outcomes and scoped memories exist, but conversation-summary recall and current-membership intersection are not complete.

capabilities.required_behavior: Operators can keep, merge, edit, and forget bounded memory through Slack App Home and the local control plane with provenance and idempotent audit.
capabilities.gap: Forget exists for some surfaces, but keep, merge, and edit review of continuity memory are incomplete.

capabilities.required_behavior: Every App Home row shows the exact request summary, deep-links to its work or source, and exposes state-specific memory, schedule, task, publication, and workspace recovery actions.
capabilities.gap: Core rows and several controls render, but exact titles, navigation, run-now, edit, publication recovery, and workspace discard are incomplete.

capabilities.required_behavior: Typed plan_goal and update_goal tools create required parent and child goals, validate prerequisites, bound independent parallelism, and prevent terminal completion while required work remains.
capabilities.gap: Required-goal counts and commitment validation exist, but model-callable goal planning, dependencies, and coordinated finalization do not.

capabilities.required_behavior: A parent episode coordinates child goals with one isolated writable repository each, exact-revision read-only companions, bounded parallelism, and explicit partial completion.
capabilities.gap: One repository per Work profile and fleet placement are enforced, but repository sets, companion snapshots, parent-child goals, and multi-workspace coordination are incomplete.

capabilities.required_behavior: Authorized Slack and control-plane actions create, replace, pause, resume, delete, and run a schedule now; each occurrence creates a fresh child episode with inspectable execution and failure history.
capabilities.gap: Durable schedules and recurrence work, but replace, run-now, complete surface coverage, and useful execution history are incomplete.

capabilities.required_behavior: Typed source subscriptions persist webhook cursor and polling fallback state so lost external events can wake the exact waiting episode without duplicate execution.
capabilities.gap: Exact event waits are durable, but generalized subscription ownership, cursors, and lost-event polling are not complete.

capabilities.required_behavior: Coop is the single source-fetch owner and every attempt records requested revision, resolved immutable revision, fetch time, remote identity, and stale-base evidence before review or publication.
capabilities.gap: Workspace and source revisions are pinned in several contracts, but fetch ownership and a complete per-attempt freshness receipt are not explicit.

capabilities.required_behavior: Stale-base, lease, push, PR-update, checks, merge, deployment, and verification transitions are durable; authorized operators can retry, update, or discard only the exact fenced publication generation.
capabilities.gap: Draft publication and follow-up are durable, but supported stale/conflict recovery actions and typed deployment verification are incomplete.

capabilities.required_behavior: Authenticated-local pages provide searchable incident, schedule, channel, repository, topology, freshness, effective configuration, MCP grant, timing, and cost detail from durable state.
capabilities.gap: Core overview, episode, failure, audit, memory, usage, and Lab pages exist, but the complete incident, schedule, channel, repository, search, topology, grant, and calibration views do not.
